# stalwart_mta_stage_connect (Data Source)

Configures SMTP connection greeting and hostname settings. This singleton object always exists: creating the resource adopts the current server settings and destroying it only removes the resource from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `hostname` (Attributes) The SMTP server hostname (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hostname))
- `id` (String) Always `singleton`.
- `script` (Attributes) Which Sieve script to run when a client connects (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--script))
- `smtp_greeting` (Attributes) The greeting message sent by the SMTP/LMTP server (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--smtp_greeting))
